stories.title: The Titans have scored 58 points through Week 5, the fewest in the NFL
stories.dek: Tennessee is 0-5, but its defense has allowed 109 points, tied for 10th-fewest — the offense is scoring at half the league rate.

stories.title: The Jaguars have allowed 36 points through Week 3, the fewest in the NFL
stories.dek: Jacksonville is 2-1, and its +46 point differential trails only unbeaten San Francisco's.
